_doc: Claude account split (auth-split PR2). accounts: configDir selects a Claude login directory (~ expands to the home directory), or Keychain fields select a long-lived token (type oauth -> CLAUDE_CODE_OAUTH_TOKEN, apikey -> ANTHROPIC_API_KEY); no secrets live in this file. daemons: launchd label (XPC_SERVICE_NAME) -> account id; build and fix use b only when enforce is true. "*": "default" leaves unmapped com.we.* / com.plateau.* labels on the default login A; "refuse" refuses them when enforce is true. enforce false disables all account routing. Interactive and non-launchd sessions always resolve to none.
